newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR sees better result in year ahead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR sees better result in year ahead.

text.p: Building products, aluminium and sugar group CSR Ltd said on Monday it expected to report better results in the year ahead than in the year just completed.
"The outlook for the year ahead is more favourable than for the year just completed," CSR said in a statement accompanying its 1996/97 results to March 31.
CSR said a modest recovery is expected in Australian building and construction activity, together with healthy levels of activity in the United States market.
But CSR said export returns from raw sugar and aluminium will be lower, unless markets improve from current levels.
"In short, we expect better results in the year ahead. We are well placed to benefit from the expected upturn in local markets and from the value created by our improvement plans."
CSR earlier reported a 36 percent fall in net profit after abnormals of A$212.2 million in the year to March 31, 1997.

It said growth opportunities in Australia are quite limited due to low immigration, an ageing population, a move away from detached housing to home units, and the relative decline in the manufacturing industry.
"We see continuing opportunities for growth in America. Specific add-on opportunities will be sought in Asia," it said.
At 1.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), CSR shares were five cents lower at A$4.72 while the overall market was stronger.
